help.title: Help & FAQ
help.contactSubtitle: Our family support team is here for you.

faq.q_1: How do I start recording a story?
faq.a_1: Go to the Home tab and tap the large red Record button. You can either choose a topic first or start recording right away. The app will guide you with questions.
faq.a_2: Yes! TimeLog works completely offline. Your recordings are saved locally and will sync to the cloud automatically when you have internet connection.
faq.q_3: How does my family listen to my stories?
faq.a_3: Your family members can link their devices using the Connection Code or QR code in your Settings. Once linked, they can listen to all your stories and leave comments.
faq.q_4: What happens if I delete a story?
faq.a_4: Deleted stories are moved to the "Deleted Items" folder where they stay for 30 days. You can restore them anytime during this period from Settings > Deleted Items.
faq.q_5: How do I turn off cloud features?
faq.a_5: Go to Settings > Privacy & Sharing and toggle off "Cloud AI & Sharing". Your local recordings will continue to work, but stories won't sync to the cloud.
faq.q_6: How can my family ask me questions?
faq.a_6: Family members can submit questions from their app. These questions will appear in your Topics tab with a "From Family" tag, so you can record answers directly.
